# CropGraph candidate fixtures

`entries.json` contains unchanged excerpts from pinned calendar release
`e722c3415bcf2773277f3422e13a4de5efd29b48`, including its calendar citation. The source manifest,
checksums and licence limitations are documented in [the source package](../../../data/sources/cropgraph/README.md).
The file-level CC BY 4.0 declaration does not establish rights in cited upstream works.

Tests use these excerpts for tomato contradictions, onion regional notes, quoted cultivars, microgreens,
mixtures and unresolved crop-form labels. Synthetic mutations exercise missing fields, duplicates, reordered
arrays and ambiguous modifier bases. No fixture represents accepted content or a commercial rights decision.
